author: david6666666
body: These new kwargs are passed even when quantization is disabled. On older supported FlashInfer builds where this function lacks the SAGE parameters, the existing dense TRTLLM_ATTN path will now raise TypeError. Please only pass them when the SAGE kernel API is available, or update the dependency globally.

author: bobboli
body: `FLASHINFER_ATTN` does not consume `backend_kwargs`, so its `quant` config is silently ignored and dense attention still runs. Please restrict `quant` to `TRTLLM_ATTN` in this PR.

author: david6666666
body: The conditional kwargs and updated dense-path coverage address this. Looks good now.
